reason: The application of lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone is out of scope: that imported lemma assumes the target A is finite-dimensional, whereas lem-maincb-error-improvement quantifies over an arbitrary extended epsilon-C*-algebra A and assumes only that the source B is finite-dimensional. Hence the lemma cannot upgrade every replacement map furnished by error improvement, in particular those with infinite-dimensional target A, so this node does not establish that c0_prime is a witness for the full error-improvement theorem. A general-target monotonicity result/direct derivation, or an explicit weakening to finite-dimensional targets, is required.
